proposals.defect: Schema validation checks against the older Draft 7 metaschema instead of Draft 2020-12, so 2020-12-only keywords (e.g. prefixItems, $defs, dependentRequired) with invalid values are accepted and later ignored by router-side validation.

The object-type check only rejects a schema when the type is a non-string, so non-object scalar types like "array" or "string" are accepted as response schemas; the router then validates against a non-object contract.
